title: compactMap, filter and reduce
summary: Parse valid integers, keep positive values and sum them in a collection pipeline.
triggers: parse optional values and aggregate only valid matching elements
prompts: Sum positive integers from text fields while skipping invalid entries.
invariant: Only successfully parsed positive integers reach the reduction.
mantra: Parse and drop nil; filter; fold.
pitfalls: map would retain Int? elements rather than dropping failures.
The initial reduce value determines the result for empty input.
